pairfor_address.meaning: pair address computed by Launchpad.pairFor() and expected by Launchpad

deployed_pair_address.meaning: actual pair address deployed by GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.createPair()

predicted_address_code_size.meaning: extcodesize at the predicted pairFor() address when a pair call is attempted
predicted_address_code_size.checkpoint: at pair call on predicted address

pair_call_reverted.meaning: whether the call to the pair on the predicted address reverted
pair_call_reverted.checkpoint: at pair call on predicted address

assumptions: Launchpad sends tokens and calls pair functions on the pairFor() predicted address.
The pair call scenario is evaluated at the predicted address rather than the factory-deployed address.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who triggers the token send or the pair call on the predicted address.
Whether tokens are actually sent and pair calls actually occur is stated only as potential, not as an established transaction.

limitations: Formalizes only the pair_call_reverts_no_code impact; token-stuck and reward/liquidity-flow impacts are not covered by this plan.
The address mismatch root cause is not encoded as a precondition; the plan binds the report's expected equality between pairFor() and the deployed pair address.
Concrete address values and code binding are deferred.
